W2.description: Multi-Tool Selection & Bloat Ablation (15 vs 54 tools vs Tool-RAG top-5)

session_and_block_design.counterbalancing: Explicit block order inversion in S2 (reverse workload and regime sequences)
session_and_block_design.warmup_policy: Separate warmup records marked with is_warmup=true, excluded from confirmatory analysis
session_and_block_design.statistical_unit: Cell (platform × workload × regime × tool × session) with median and IQR/MAD; randomized rep index does NOT imply temporal pairing

confirmatory.description: T_orch of Compiled Native (Go) is significantly lower than Managed Event-Driven (Node.js) under Warm KV-cache (Regime B)
confirmatory.test: Moving Block Bootstrap (MBB) + Two One-Sided Tests (TOST)

confirmatory.description: Inter-session replication equivalence between S1 and S2 within ±10% margin
confirmatory.test: Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) on paired cell medians

confirmatory.description: Tool-RAG dynamic pruning mitigates KV-cache prefix thrashing, reducing latency >10x vs unpruned 54-tool catalog
In Cold Prefill (Regime A), neural computation accounts for >75% of latency, yielding practical equivalence across runtimes

exploratory_and_diagnostic.description: Microarchitectural instruction retirement counts across runtimes (diagnostic activity proxy, not standalone efficiency)
Electrical energy dissipation across heterogeneous hardware probes (Apple SMC vs Linux RAPL vs NVIDIA NVML)
Directional drift and OS scheduler affinity analysis across consecutive experimental sessions

pre_defined_exclusion_criteria: http_status != 200 (unless the trial belongs to an explicit fault-injection ablation)
prompt_tokens diverges by more than 5% from workload contract in equalized arms
missing mandatory provenance fields (session_id, timestamp_iso, git_commit, etc.)
physical sensor read failure resulting in NaN or Inf

statistical_methods.primary_inference: Moving Block Bootstrap (MBB, B=10000) under the null hypothesis
statistical_methods.adaptive_block_size_rule: Politis-White AR(1) formula: b = ceil((2 * r1 / (1 - r1^2))^(2/3) * n^(1/3)) bounded in [2, floor(n/2)]
statistical_methods.equivalence_framework: Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) with 90% confidence interval duality
statistical_methods.p_value_adjustment: Holm-Bonferroni step-down correction for family-wise error control
